prompt: Create a transparent-background 2-column by 2-row atlas of ONLY four strict horizontal floor-edge SIDE elevations. Row 1 is the EDGE transition in reference image 1; row 2 is the CORNER transition in reference image 2. Column 1 RIGHT, column 2 LEFT. Each cell shows the object from a level straight-on horizontal camera, not overhead and not below. All rails remain physically horizontal at one shared Z height. In every side cell show only the shallow slab depth profile with the rail seen END-ON at the correct far/near edge: the rail appears as a SHORT HORIZONTAL band/cap near the top of the slab, never a tall upright post or vertical L. Keep a horizontal slab thickness band beneath it. The edge transition has one boundary rail; the corner transition has rails along two adjacent boundaries in its accepted TOP, but do not turn that plan L vertical: project the visible end(s) horizontally at the same height. Preserve orange/rusted red-gray steel, bolt plates and yellow-black hazard stripes from the exact row source. No full square floor face, no broad front-facing long rail, no full-height upright bar, no generic black board, no added parts. Transparent gutters, centered orthographic view. Inferred principal views, not recovered pixels or calibrated 3D.

reference_inputs.role: source with accepted top and bottom as orientation/material anchor
source with accepted top and bottom as orientation/material anchor

geometry_constraints: side elevations show slab depth and rail end-on
rail remains horizontal at shared world Z
no broad face of rail and no upright L/post
preserve one-sided edge and adjacent-corner rail identities
internal_qa_failure: Output repeated top-down floor panels for front/rear and full-height upright rail-post projections for right/left; no candidates normalized or installed.
